name: pp-coach-tracker-api
description: API de pp-coach-tracker: recibe los chunks de 10 fps que sube la app y coordina el worker

scripts.php:migrate: wsl -e docker compose exec -T php php bin/migrate.php
scripts.viewer:up: wsl -e docker compose --profile viewer up -d --build viewer
scripts.worker:up: wsl -e docker compose --profile worker up -d --build worker
scripts.worker:test: wsl -e docker compose --profile worker run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint python worker -m pytest -q tests
scripts.worker:prod:once: wsl -e docker compose -f ../worker/docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file ../.env run --rm worker once
